description: Codex: Orks (11e) STOMPING JUGGERNAUT (Dread Mob, 1 CP) through the real unit_declares_charge window, then a real charge THROUGH a dense wall (r2:F2). 13.06: a MOBILE unit can move through dense terrain, so the charge must not pay the climb penalty. Setup privileges: Dread Mob detachment; the Killa Kans are moved ~4" behind Custodian Guard E with a tall (6") dense ruin wall between them (the script proves that wall costs a non-MOBILE walker 12" of charge distance); P1 CP 1 (no Command Re-roll prompt after the stratagem), P2 CP 0 (no Fire Overwatch interlude); the charge roll's dice are seeded. Real clicks: the Kans in the charge list, Custodian Guard E as the target, Declare Charge -> the window offers STOMPING JUGGERNAUT -> Use (1 CP, MOBILE) -> Roll Charge: the roll succeeds (before the fix the charge phase ignored the stratagem's MOBILE and failed every roll: ~3" gap + 12" climb) -> Snap to contact -> Confirm: the Kans end the charge in engagement on the far side of the wall.

steps.comment: the tall (6") dense wall costs a non-MOBILE walker 12" of charge distance (climb up + down, 13.06); a MOBILE one passes through for free

steps.script:
var cc = tree.root.get_node("Main").charge_controller
var sb = cc.unit_selector.get_v_scroll_bar()
sb.value = 60
return true

steps.comment: r2:F2: the charge phase's terrain checks now see the stratagem's MOBILE
deterministic dice for the charge roll
r2:F2: the roll is checked without the 12" climb penalty — a 9 is enough (before the fix the ~3" gap + 12" climb made every roll fail)

steps.script:
var ys = []
for m in GameState.get_unit("U_KILLA_KANS_A").models:
	ys.append(float(m["position"]["y"]) / 40.0)
print("[ork11e SJ charge] Kan y after the charge move: ", ys)
return ys.min() < 44.4
steps.comment: the Kans stand on the far side of the wall
core Tank Shock offer after a VEHICLE charge (not under test)
